title: Pink Car Interior Accessories
intro: Your car is the room you sit in most days, so it may as well be pink. This kit covers every spot you touch: a rhinestone steering wheel cover, soft seat belt covers, cup holder coasters, heart vent clips, a phone holder that actually stays put and a tiny trash can for the receipts and straw wrappers that used to live in the door pocket. Nothing here needs tools and nothing here is permanent, so it works in a lease. Every red light becomes a little photo shoot, and the coffee run gets a lot more fun.

items.name: Pink heart rhinestone vent clips, 4 pack
